screens.title: Sky Light · Ordinary details
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one realistic Android Remilo evaluation screenshot.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an approved R4 page composition with documented raster discrepancies. Image 2 is the HOMEPAGE ATMOSPHERE REFERENCE, controlling this variant's landscape, palette and Light/Dark appearance. Create a theme variant of Image1, not an independent redesign.
Output exactly ONE flat full portrait screenshot, approximately840x1870pixels (a realistic360x800dp viewport), no device frame, poster, comparison board, labels outside the screen, or new marketing copy.
Preserve all page content, values, event/Due/alert semantics, field ordering, typography hierarchy and controls from Image1. Keep the compact secondary header; do NOT paste the homepage's tall hero, title Remilo, tabs, filter chips or Add FAB. Crop/recompose the SAME reference landscape to a shallow compact opening with quiet toolbar background. Toolbar56dp plus artcrop40dp below24dp status inset; content begins about120dp /15% down the screen. Artwork remains recognisable and integrated.
APPLY THE ALREADY-DOCUMENTED CORRECTIONS: All ordinary structural field icons (When/calendar/time/Due/Alarm mode/Alert time/Repeat/List/Notes/settings-disclosure) and chevrons must be consistently NEUTRAL slate in Light or light-gray in Dark, in shared neutral icon containers. No arbitrary orange, blue, pink or purple tint on these passive icons. Ordinary labels/support text neutral, primary values onSurface. Toolbar Back/Edit/More share contrast-protected neutral content. Theme PRIMARY is reserved for actual Done/Save, Postpone alert action, focused outline/caret and explicit selection. Category badges retain their independent categorical colors; a plant badge remains green, document category badge indigo. Explicit status remains semantic: Scheduledgreen, Overdueamber with text; don't color Alarm because status differs. Independent relationship badges neutralgray, not colored selected chips.
Card anatomy, label alignment, icon-column size, padding and radius are shared across variants. Use one shared information/settings glyph for Schedule details rather than the original list glyph. List row has a neutral chevron when it opens a destination. Avoid appearance-specific pill buttons: same primary56dp height (roughly130px on840wide image),16dp radius and16dp sidemargins. Postpone outlined action48dp high (about112px); otherinteractiveareas>=48dp. Main text16sp (~37px), supporting14sp (~33px), detailstitle24sp (~56px). Preserve normal readable typography; allow lower disclosures belowfold instead of shrinking.
Reading surfaces are solid/opaque. Long title/notes naturally wrap. Footer sits outside scroll content, with safe gesture padding; no rootbottomnavigation or FAB on these screens. Keep these as consistent screens of one app.

Theme and appearance:
Match the attached SKY LIGHT homepage exactly in style: clear airy cyan/blue daylight sky, soft white clouds, blue mountain layers, green conifers/meadows and reflective blue lake. NO sun disk needed, NO moon/stars, NO sunrise orange or sunset colors. Light content is very pale cool-blue/offwhite with opaque white cards, dark navy primary text and neutral slate supporting/glyphs. Actual action accent is saturated mediumBLUE with WHITE text on filledbuttons, bluePostponeoutline/focus. Compress landscape into the shallow header without losing this midday identity.

When card: "When"; "Today · Wed, 7 Oct"; "10:00–10:15 AM"; concise "Due at event start". DO NOT create a redundant separate10AM Due row.
Alarm card: NEUTRAL alarm-clock icon, "Alarm", labeled green "Scheduled", "Today at 10:00 AM", "At due time". Outlined primary-colored "Postpone alert" button. Category/state colors separate from structural icons.
List: neutralglyph "List", "Home", chevron. Notes: neutralglyph "Notes"; "Water the balcony herbs and check the soil before adding more water."
Shared neutral disclosure glyph and row "Schedule details", chevron. Persistentfilled "Done" action. No keyboard. Keep complete content without shrinking.

refinement.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the SKY LIGHT ordinary Reminder details candidate. Change ONLY the small leading gear icon on the "Schedule details" row to a neutral gray INFORMATION glyph (circled lowercase i), to match the read-only disclosure glyph used in Dark details. Keep it the same visual size/stroke/container style. Ensure "Postpone alert" outline/text uses the SAME blue primary hue as the existing filled "Done" background; preserve hierarchy outlined vs filled. Preserve EVERY other pixel/layout feature as closely as possible: landscape/art/colors, full portrait dimensions, all text and values, green plant badge, green Scheduled state, neutral gray structural icons, cards, typography, buttons, clock7:30. Do not remove, add or reorder content. No new design.
